data.spiritual_symbolism: Diogenia is a Christian name inspired by Diogenes the Cynic, an ancient Greek philosopher known for his simplicity and self-sufficiency. This name symbolizes a deep commitment to a humble, ascetic lifestyle rooted in spiritual discipline and detachment from worldly possessions. It is a reminder to live in imitation of Christ, embracing the virtues of poverty, simplicity, and inner peace, in service to God and neighbor.
